formatVersion.description: Version of the example enrichment format.

operation.description: Explicitly identifies this payload as an update to existing words.

allOf.description: Optional explanation shown after the answer, such as a useful collocation, register note, or nuance.

Japanese example sentence containing exactly one {{word}} marker where the canonical word should be inserted. The word must fit without conjugation. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.
Intended translation for the example. It is hidden by default and shown when the learner requests a hint or reveals the answer.
Examples to append to an existing word. A malformed example rejects this word while other valid words remain importable.

Existing Japanese word or expression to enrich. Use the exact text produced by the library export. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.
Existing words whose example catalogs should be expanded. Each word is processed independently.

title: Word example enrichment JSON
description: JSON payload for appending practice examples to words already in the library.
